Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. The supplier shall design, print, manufacture, supply and, wherever specified in the p

urchase order, install the flex banners and signage boards according to the approved artwork, dimensions and technical specifications. 2. Artwork Approval. The buyer shall provide required text, logos, photographs and other content, or ap prove artwork submitted by the supplier, before printing. No printing shall be undertaken without approval . 3. Material Quality. All materials shall be new, unused and free from defects. Flex material, ACP panels, vinyl, lettering and steel frames shall conform to the specifications stated in the bid. Material substitution r equires prior written approval. 4. Dimensions and Tolerances. Dimensions shall be as specified against each item. Any permitted man ufacturing tolerance shall be stated in the bid. The supplier shall obtain approval before making any deviat ion. 5. Printing and Finishing. Printing shall be clear, legible, properly aligned and free from smudges, strea ks, colour patches and other visible defects. Edges, eyelets, laminations, lettering and mounting arrangem ents shall be neatly finished. 6. Delivery Period. Materials shall be delivered within 15 days from the purchase order or approved artw ork, as specified in the bid. Delivery location: 1881 Med Regt, Binnaguri, WB. 8. Installation. Where installation is included, the supplier shall provide necessary manpower, tools, mou nting accessories and approved fixing arrangements. Installation shall be stable and safe; damage caused by installation work shall be repaired by the supplier. 9. Transportation and Packing. The supplier shall bear the cost and responsibility for proper packing, lo ading, transportation and unloading up to the specified delivery location, unless the bid states otherwise. 10. Warranty and Defect Liability. The supplier shall provide a warranty of 12 months from acceptance , if required by the buyer. Defects attributable to the supplier, including peeling, faulty fixing and printing defects, shall be rectified or replaced at no additional cost during the agreed warranty period. 11. Payment Terms. Payment shall be made after satisfactory delivery, inspection and acceptance, subj ect to submission of the required invoice and supporting documents and applicable financial rules. .
